product_entry: Save the accepted series program in Drawing studio. On reopen, use the named chart-header button. Use Edit layout to select another saved layout. Blank AI workbench opens an independent studio.
storage: The optional series-drawing-1 attachment is stored in the existing layout save, history and undo transaction. Scalar values are in source declaration order. Exact observations, selection, derived drawing output and rejected drafts are session-only.
recovery: The v11 marker and ledger update are atomic. The old writer refuses this format. Reopen a closed pre-upgrade v10 backup with the old reader or keep the upgraded profile with the current reader. No table or legacy JSON rewrite is necessary.
scope: Linux Chromium, current Rust writer, confirmed synthetic CSV. This slice does not qualify a physical package or the M2-013 authored text and disclosure journey.
